artifacts.summary: 15-phase per-class, per-site reword of 223 source-store files naming the three deleted lifecycle commands, with a three-class rubric, the revise.md incidentals, and a terminal redeploy plus full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: suite_selection_select is not a usable narrowing mechanism for plan phases whose files are markdown. Its stratum-(b) grep lookup resolves a touched path by BASENAME, so any path named SKILL.md or README.md matches every suite that textually references that basename -- measured 28 suites for a 14-file founder/skills set and 43 for a 21-file small-extensions set. Two consequences for plan authoring: a suite-subset Tier Justification for such a phase is neither writable in one line nor a real narrowing, and claiming the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel for those sets is affirmatively false (the selector does map them). Pure-directory markdown sets whose basenames are distinctive (core/context/patterns/*.md) do correctly return __FULL_SWEEP__. The correct grounding for a markdown phase's Tier Justification is the gate-subset mechanism (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N[,M...]), which plan-format.md explicitly places outside the suite-selection measurement check's scope.
